nodes.label: AppError error envelope with stable error codes
nodes.norm_label: apperror error envelope with stable error codes
nodes.rationale: Clients localize by error code (ru/kk/en), so codes are API contract: add new ones freely, never rename existing ones.

nodes.label: Enum rule: StrEnum in code, VARCHAR + CHECK in database
nodes.norm_label: enum rule: strenum in code, varchar + check in database
nodes.rationale: No PostgreSQL enum types; enums are VARCHAR columns guarded by CHECK constraints.

nodes.label: Double-booking prevention by PostgreSQL exclusion constraints (btree_gist)
nodes.norm_label: double-booking prevention by postgresql exclusion constraints (btree_gist)
nodes.rationale: The database guarantees no overlapping active bookings per PC and per user; the service only maps the violation to an error code. Must not be replaced with a check-then-insert in Python, which would be racy.

nodes.label: Injected Clock (never call datetime.now())
nodes.rationale: Time is taken from the injected Clock so tests can control it.

nodes.label: Integrations behind typing.Protocols with mocks
nodes.rationale: External systems sit behind Protocols so a real adapter is a new file plus one registry line; services must not change. Only mocks exist so far.

nodes.label: Layering rule: router -> service -> domain
nodes.rationale: Routers only parse input and shape output; services hold the use-case and commit; domain stays free of I/O so business rules are testable in isolation.

nodes.label: Lazy expiry of unpaid holds (10 min hold)
nodes.norm_label: lazy expiry of unpaid holds (10 min hold)
nodes.rationale: Unpaid holds are expired lazily on create/list/get/pay and ignored by availability queries, so no background worker is needed yet.

nodes.label: Money rule: whole tenge as int, _kzt suffix
nodes.norm_label: money rule: whole tenge as int, _kzt suffix
nodes.rationale: Whole tenge integers avoid float and Decimal rounding issues.

nodes.label: Multi-tenancy: organizations -> clubs -> zones -> pcs
nodes.rationale: Staff are scoped to one organization; every admin query filters by staff.organization_id and answers 404 (not 403) for other organizations' data so existence is not leaked. Customers are global.

nodes.label: ENVIRONMENT=prod guard (refuses dev secrets or fixed OTP code)
nodes.norm_label: environment=prod guard (refuses dev secrets or fixed otp code)
nodes.rationale: Production must never start with development secrets or a predictable OTP code, so startup fails instead of running insecurely.

nodes.label: Pure domain layer (no I/O: iin, age_rule, slots, pricing, phone)
nodes.norm_label: pure domain layer (no i/o: iin, age_rule, slots, pricing, phone)
nodes.rationale: domain/ has no database, no HTTP and no datetime.now(); everything it needs is passed in, which keeps business rules deterministic and unit-testable without a database.

nodes.label: Integration tests against real PostgreSQL in a rolled-back transaction
nodes.norm_label: integration tests against real postgresql in a rolled-back transaction
nodes.rationale: Behaviour that depends on the database is tested through the API against real PostgreSQL, never with SQLite or a mocked session; each test runs inside a rolled-back transaction.

nodes.label: requires_overlap_constraints test marker
nodes.rationale: These tests need a real PostgreSQL (TEST_DATABASE_URL, database name containing 'test'). The embedded server lacks btree_gist so they are skipped there; a green run with skips does not prove overlap protection.

nodes.label: Row-lock order: booking, then payment
nodes.rationale: A single consistent lock order (booking first, then payment) prevents deadlocks between concurrent booking and payment operations.

nodes.label: Time rule: UTC timestamptz storage, club-local IANA timezone evaluation
nodes.norm_label: time rule: utc timestamptz storage, club-local iana timezone evaluation
nodes.rationale: Store UTC; every club has an IANA timezone (default Asia/Almaty, UTC+5) and anything about time of day is evaluated in club-local time. Naive datetimes are rejected at the API.

nodes.label: UUIDv7 IDs generated in the app (double as pagination cursors)
nodes.norm_label: uuidv7 ids generated in the app (double as pagination cursors)
nodes.rationale: UUIDv7 values are time-ordered, so they double as pagination cursors.

nodes.label: Embedded PostgreSQL test fallback (no btree_gist)
nodes.rationale: Without TEST_DATABASE_URL the integration tests can fall back to an embedded PostgreSQL, but the double-booking tests are skipped there because that server has no btree_gist extension.

nodes.label: can_play_at(): single-instant age check for the future PC client
nodes.norm_label: can_play_at(): single-instant age check for the future pc client

nodes.label: adult_from(): adulthood starts 00:00 club-local on the 18th birthday
nodes.norm_label: adult_from(): adulthood starts 00:00 club-local on the 18th birthday
nodes.rationale: 29 Feb birthdays become adult on 1 Mar. This is the only place that encodes that interpretation of adulthood.

nodes.label: Age rule: under-18 users cannot book or play during [22:00, 06:00) club-local
nodes.norm_label: age rule: under-18 users cannot book or play during [22:00, 06:00) club-local
nodes.rationale: Half-open window: ending at exactly 22:00 and starting at exactly 06:00 are allowed. A booking is rejected if any instant of it is both at night and before adulthood.

nodes.label: IIN PII protection (Fernet encryption + HMAC uniqueness, masked, never logged)
nodes.norm_label: iin pii protection (fernet encryption + hmac uniqueness, masked, never logged)
nodes.rationale: The IIN is personal data: stored encrypted, an HMAC provides uniqueness without decrypting, it is returned only masked and never logged.

nodes.label: Kazakhstan personal-data localization requirement
nodes.rationale: Kazakhstan law requires storing citizens' personal data on servers inside Kazakhstan, which constrains production hosting.
